title: Alapin Sicilian
name: Alapin Sicilian (2.c3)
summary: 1.e4 c5 2.c3. You keep a pawn centre. This drill is the two replies you meet most, 2...d5 and 2...Nf6, each through move 8. A wrong move is refused.
blurb: 2.c3, then a pawn centre. You play White.
tell: Black has played 1...c5 and you have answered 2.c3, not 2.Nf3. The c-pawn is there so that when Black takes on d4 you can take back with a pawn and keep two central pawns.
structure: Against 2...d5 the black queen lands on d5. After ...cxd4 and cxd4 you usually have an isolated d-pawn: a strength while pieces are on, a target if they all come off. Against 2...Nf6 you push e5, the knight goes to d5, and you hold pawns on d4 and e5.
pieces: You: knight on f3, light-squared bishop on e2 or c4, dark-squared bishop on e3, the other knight to c3 once the c-pawn has moved, king castled short.
Black, 2...d5: queen on d5, knight on f6, often ...Bg4 pinning your knight, knight on c6, king castled short.
Black, 2...Nf6: the knight is driven from f6 to d5 and often on to b6. They hit your centre with ...d6 and ...Nc6.

white: Play d4 on move three, unless they have just hit e4. Then exd5 against ...d5, and e5 against ...Nf6.
Develop Nf3, a bishop, and castle. Do not chase the d5 queen with pawns. After ...cxd4 cxd4, Nc3 comes with tempo.
Against the pin ...Bg4, Be2 and castling are enough. When you are ahead later, trade queens first.
black: 2...d5: develop fast, pin the f3 knight with ...Bg4, and take on d4 so the d-pawn is isolated.
2...Nf6: ...d6 and ...Nc6 chip at e5. The knight on d5 wants a square when you play Bc4.

breaks: You: d2-d4 at once, so the c3-pawn can recapture.
Black: ...d5 against e4, or ...d6 against the e5-pawn in the 2...Nf6 line.

traps.name: ...Bg4 before Nf3
traps.point: With no knight on f3 the bishop on g4 is loose: the queen on d1 sees it. Take it.

traps.name: The knight must move
traps.point: After 3.e5 the knight on f6 is attacked by a pawn. A slow move such as 3...e6 drops it to 4.exf6.

lines.name: 2...d5 main
lines.note: The move you meet most. exd5, d4, Nf3, Be2, castle, Be3. Do not chase the queen.

lines.name: 2...d5, early ...cxd4
lines.note: They take on d4 before developing. cxd4 frees c3, and Nc3 hits the queen.

lines.name: 2...Nf6
lines.note: They hit e4 with a knight. e5, d4, Nf3, cxd4, Bc4, and Bb5 after ...Nb6.
